39
The half-life of a radioactive substance is 5 hours. A sample is tested and found to contain 0.48 g
of the substance.
How much of the substance was present in the sample 20 hours before the sample was tested?
A
0.03 g
B
0.12 g
C
1.92 g
D
7.68 g
subject: Physics
